Messages.Author: mjvtes521
Messages.Body: Can as many ready vamps that you have with chimerstry add counters to eat each untap phase or just one?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> mjasper521 wrote:
> Can as many ready vamps that you have with chimerstry add counters to eat each untap phase or just one?
>
The phrasing "During X, you may do Y...." and similar phrasing (the key word to look for is "during") restricts you to once. From the rulebook:

“During X, do Y”: The “during X do Y” template is used in several cards. When this template is used, only one Y can be done per X with this card. For instance, you may move blood from your vampire to your pool with Vessel only once per untap phase.

So during your untap phase, one of your Chimerical vampires can put one blood on it.

thank you in advance

RjdLts

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> delangen wrote:
> if I have an illusory resource in play and am being bled by supension of disbelief does it require extra counter to be burned?
>
No. It increases the cost of cards by one blood or life. The cost of a card is only really relevant when you're playing it (or possibly at certain other times, like Kindred Segregation or Peace Treaty). You're not playing a card when you're burning a counter, so the cost of the card is irrelevant.
